problem.title: Reverse Linked List
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; original Chinese explanation and proof.
facts: Reverse the next pointers of a singly linked list.
The empty and single-node lists are valid boundary cases.

claims.claim: At each iteration prev is the reversed prefix and curr is the untouched suffix head.
Each node is visited once and only three references are maintained, giving O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
